requirements.title: Education and English level
requirements.body: A recognized academic degree is required. Applicants must have fluent & native English language and demonstrate excellent spoken and written communication skills. Teaching experience and experience working with children are an advantage.

roles.title: Roles and placements
roles.body: Bridges recruits qualified teachers for a range of full-time and part-time roles in schools across the Negev. Placements depend on current program needs. Details are discussed individually with suitable candidates.

applyHow.title: Three steps to teaching with Bridges.
applyHow.intro: A short form beats emailing a CV into the void. Fill it in and we'll take it from there.
steps: Fill in the short form below — name, phone, email, English background, academic degree, location, one line on why you want to teach with Bridges, and your CV.
Complete a two-stage interview process with our team.
Successful candidates may proceed to onboarding and placement, subject to current program needs and completion of all required checks and documents.
